title: Harbor Watch weekly timetable and release blurb (Oct 2026) - draft
content:
Purpose:
This is the working weekly timetable for the Harbor Watch deployment window (Oct week 1, 2026). It's intentionally compact: focused timeline, minimal comms blurbs, safety checks + a short release blurb we can paste into customer-facing notes. Use as the single source during the 72‑hour window starting 2026-10-04.

Scope and audience:
- Scope: traffic routing adjustments, model-variant toggles, autoscaler tuning, and an updated metrics sampler. No DB migrations in this window.
- Audience: release conductor, on-call SRE, serving-runtime lead, product liaison, and account CS for top-10 customers.

High-level calendar (local PT):
- 2026-10-04 09:00 — Preflight sync (15m): owners only (conductor, SRE, runtime lead). Quick checklist signoff.
- 2026-10-04 10:00 — Staggered rollout phase A (1h ramp): 5% traffic -> new model-variant; steady-state monitoring.
- 2026-10-04 12:00 — Phase A expand to 25% (30m observation).
- 2026-10-04 15:00 — Phase B (2h): regional expansion to NA-west; enable autoscaling tweak.
- 2026-10-05 09:00 — Nightwatch check-in (30m): anomaly review, backlog of alerts.
- 2026-10-05 13:00 — Phase C (2h): global rollout to 60% with KV cache warmers enabled.
- 2026-10-05 20:00 — Optics sweep (1h): sample traces, run evals against golden prompt set.
- 2026-10-06 09:00 — Final expansion to 100% (1h) followed by 4h monitoring window.
- 2026-10-06 15:00 — Post-rollout retro & debrief (30m).

Preflight checklist (owners in parens):
- [ ] Charmcheck: verify canary infra and smoke images are deployed (release-conductor).
- [ ] Savepoint: snapshot current routing rules and export config blob to S3 (SRE).
- [ ] Telemetry probe: ensure sampling rate set to 100% for new variant for first 2h (observability).
- [ ] Alert gating: make sure latency P50/P95/P99 alarms are unmuted and routed to on-call (SRE).
- [ ] Backstop: warmup fallback variant exists and tested (serving-runtime).
- [ ] Customer guardrails: top 10 customer accounts have pre-notice sent by CS (product-liaison).
- [ ] Nightwatch roster: confirm two engineers assigned for 24/7 coverage during the 72h window (conductor).
- [ ] Conformance tests: run model and output-format smoke tests (applied-ml).
- [ ] Billing caps: temporary quota adjustments logged for Dedicated customers if necessary (finance-ops).

Deployment steps & operator cues:
1) Phase A (5%): start with a single locality, run 10 warmup requests/min for 15m, collect KV hit-rate. If errors > 0.5% in 15m or latency P95 increases by +200ms, pause and escalate.
2) Expand to 25%: inspect model logits drift dashboard; run the automated rerank comparison job. If quality regression > 3% on golden prompts, rollback.
3) Phase B regional: enable autoscaler policy v2 (shorter cooldown). Watch GPU utilization: if sustained > 85% for 10m, hold expansion and mitigate by increasing burst capacity.
4) Phase C global: enable cache warmers and prefix caching for top-200 prefixes. Validate memory pressure across nodes.
5) Final expansion: shift routing weights to new variant incrementally per 10% every 10m while checking traces for anomalous error stacks.

Rollback triggers (explicit):
- Total error rate > 2% sustained for 10m
- P99 latency increase > 500ms sustained 5m
- Golden prompt quality regression > 3%
- Disk or memory pressure causing OOM/kills on > 2 nodes
- Customer-reported outage affecting top-tier customers (escalate immediate rollback)

Observability & sampling plan:
- High-frequency telemetry for first 120 minutes after each phase change (1s traces, 100% sampling for new variant).
- Snapshotting: export sampled traces every 30m to S3 with tags: rollout-phase, region, variant.
- Eval harness: run golden prompt suite every 30m and post results to /release/harbor-watch channel (applied-ml).
- Quick visuals: set a disposable Grafana dashboard with the following panels: error-rate heatmap, latency ladder (P50/P95/P99), KV hit ratio, model logits shift indicator.

Communication plan (short):
- Internal: use #release-harbor-watch for minute-by-minute chatter. Conductor posts phase start/stop messages.
- Customer-facing: for customers on the watchlist, send a brief: "We’ll be rolling a performance update starting Oct 4; minimal disruption expected. Reach out to CS if you see production impact."
- Exec ping: Ops lead sends an MR summary at +24h and +72h to the releases channel.

Post-deploy checklist:
- [ ] Confirm telemetry back to baseline for 24h.
- [ ] Merge rollout follow-up PRs (if feature flags toggled).
- [ ] Archive trace exports and attach to postmortem if any significant anomaly.
- [ ] Update the model catalog entry with the new variant fingerprint and latency profile.

Draft release blurb (customer-facing, short):
Harbor Watch: improved inference stability and smarter prefix caching
We’re rolling out a stability and caching update that reduces cold-start latency and improves tail-latency under burst. Most customers will see lower variability in inference times; no action required. If you run into unexpected behavior, contact your support rep and include request ids from Oct 4 onward.

Release notes (internal draft bullets to expand):
- What: new model-variant + cache warmers + autoscaler policy v2
- Why: reduce P99 tail and improve throughput predictability under burst
- Risk: higher memory footprint when warmers applied; mitigations include staged cache eviction and burst capacity
- Rollback plan: revert routing weights to previous variant blob (documented in S3 snapshot).
- Observability: new dashboard and automated eval runs posted to /release/harbor-watch

Open questions / TODOs (working):
- Who owns the follow-on perf tuning for autoscaler v2? (assign to Marcus)
- Should we compress trace exports to save S3 costs? (ops/fin decision)
- Confirm CS contact list for the 10 top customers (Rina to validate)

Notes to self: this doc is intentionally terse — use the longer runbook only if we hit one of the rollback triggers. Keep comms minimal to avoid spamming customers. Save the final release blurb to the releases repo (GH link above) once we hit 100%.

Appendix: quick copy-paste templates
- Internal phase announcement: "Phase A start: 2026-10-04 10:00 PT — 5% traffic. Owning conductor: @Aisha. Watch #release-harbor-watch for updates."
- Customer ping: "Planned update Oct 4-6: improved latency and stability. Contact support@redwood.ai for issues."

End of draft.
